review_notes: Unconfigured fixed catalog has three functions and no tables/views/COPY formats. Selected edges.pmtiles configuration adds areas and roads tables. Snapshot is the complete union for these documented configurations: five logical named surfaces. Future tilesets have data-dependent layer names/schema, not an invented global static denominator.
